jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. About the team In our Retail & Consumer Business Unit , we bring everything we have learned in more than a decade of Applied AI and use it to help leading retailers, consumer brands, marketplaces, and digital commerce businesses navigate a rapidly evolving landscape. We develop and embed AI solutions that help organisations better understand their customers, optimise operations, improve forecasting and decision-making, and unlock new opportunities for growth. From supply chains and merchandising to marketing, personalisation, and customer experience, we work with clients to deliver measurable commercial impact through AI. We are proud to combine technical excellence with practical deployment, ensuring solutions create value in complex, real-world environments. About the role Join us as a Machine Learning Engineer to deliver bespoke, impactful AI solutions for our diverse Retail & Consumer clients. You will be instrumental in bringing machine learning out of the lab and into the real world, contributing to scalable software architecture and defining best practices. Working closely with clients and cross-functional teams, you’ll ensure the technical feasibility and successful delivery of high-quality, production-grade ML systems that drive tangible business outcomes. What you’ll be doing Building and deploying production-grade ML software, tools, and infrastructure. Creating reusable, scalable solutions that accelerate the delivery of AI and machine learning systems across retail and consumer use cases. Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product teams, and commercial leads to solve critical client challenges. Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions to ensure project feasibility, scalability, and commercial impact. Defining and implementing Faculty’s standards for deploying machine learning systems in production. Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex ML concepts into actionable business outcomes. Applying machine learning to challenges such as demand forecasting, customer analytics, personalisation, pricing, marketing optimisation, inventory management, and operational efficiency. Supporting clients in adopting AI capabilities that improve customer experiences and drive sustainable growth. Who we’re looking for You understand the full machine learning lifecycle and have experience operationalising models built with frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch. You possess strong Python skills and solid experience in software engineering best practices. You bring hands-on experience with cloud platforms and infrastructure (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture and security. You’ve worked with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale. You are comfortable with core ML concepts, including probability, statistics, experimentation, and common machine learning techniques. Experience working with retail, consumer, ecommerce, marketing, supply chain, or customer data is beneficial but not essential. You’re an excellent communicator, able to guide technical teams and confidently advise non-technical stakeholders. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy the autonomy to own scope, solve challenging problems, and deliver impactful solutions. Our interview process Talent Team Screen (30 mins) Pair Programming Interview (90 mins) System Design Interview (90 mins) Commercial Interview (60 mins) Our Recruitment Ethos We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI. Product ownership experience, including backlog management, requirements gathering, and ROI tracking. Experience in manufacturing, defense, maritime, or aftermarket service environments. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Customer Value Forecasting
jobs.jd:
S'more about the team

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist in our Customer Value Forecasting Squad inside the Customer Value Optimization Tribe to help build scalable machine learning models and predictive frameworks that drive value forecasting products at HelloFresh. As a Senior Data Scientist, your work will be pivotal in enabling our team to derive actionable insights, develop production-grade predictive models, and advance our customer valuation capabilities. Additionally, you will master the design and development of robust machine learning solutions capable of processing massive datasets and supporting critical business workflows.

Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for

  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers in a cross-functional team to improve HelloFresh’s customer value forecasting accuracy and efficiency.
  • Take ownership of the end-to-end machine learning lifecycle, including research, feature formulation, model development, validation, and monitoring for production-level inference.
  • Mentor junior team members and promote best practices in statistical modeling, experiment design, and data science methodology across the team.
  • Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in data science and machine learning. Propose and implement methodological improvements or advanced algorithms to enhance predictive modeling accuracy and team efficiency.
  • Design and refine predictive frameworks to determine optimal personalized recommendations and sequential customer interventions in real-time.
  • All other duties, as assigned

Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for

  • A passion for solving complex business problems with advanced machine learning and statistical modeling within a fast-paced environment. Experience with customer lifetime value modeling or personalization is a plus.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with expertise in data science libraries (e.g., pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) and ML frameworks (e.g., CatBoost, LightGBM, PyTorch/TensorFlow). Experience processing large-scale data and working with Spark is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience designing, training, evaluating, and deploying large-scale predictive models and machine learning pipelines for production use cases.
  • Pick up new technologies and modeling methodologies quickly while solving actual business problems.
  • Interest in working with modern data science tooling such as cloud platforms, MLOps platforms, experimentation tools, version control, and model monitoring frameworks.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • An AI-native mindset, continuously leveraging generative AI tools and workflows to enhance productivity, code quality, and problem-solving efficiency.

Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here

  • Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
  • Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
  • RRSP Matching - Competitive RRSP matching program offered
  • Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance. 
  • Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
  • Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team
  • Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
  • Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
  • Food Puns - this one is kind of a big dill if you haven’t already noticed. We even have some punny meeting room names!

Flexible Hybrid Approach

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience. 

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

jobs.title: Partner Applied AI Engineer, Google Cloud
jobs.jd: ABOUT THE TEAM The Applied AI Engineering team helps developers and enterprises deploy generative AI safely and effectively. We serve as trusted technical advisors, helping customers and partners move from early experimentation to production-scale AI systems. As a Partner Applied AI Engineer focused on Google Cloud, you will help customers build with OpenAI in the cloud environment they already use. You will work with Google Cloud and its partner ecosystem to turn early implementations into repeatable approaches that field teams can deliver independently. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an experienced technical leader to serve as a primary technical counterpart to Google Cloud Customer Engineers, AI specialists, and partner technical teams. You will shape joint technical strategy, define engagement models, and build systems that scale beyond individual deals. Working across pre- and post-sales, you will guide enterprise customers from discovery through production while enabling Google Cloud and its partners to lead subsequent deployments. This role combines hands-on engineering, technical judgment, and ecosystem leadership. You will bring deep familiarity with Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI), particularly Model Garden and its Python SDK tooling, and help customers choose supported OpenAI integration paths based on workload requirements, model capabilities, security controls, and operational needs. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: Strategic Google Cloud engagement and influence - Build trusted relationships with Google Cloud field leadership, Customer Engineers, AI specialists, and partner teams across regions. - Influence joint account strategy and identify new opportunities where OpenAI can improve customer outcomes within Google Cloud environments. - Define engagement models and prioritization frameworks that concentrate technical effort on high-impact opportunities and reusable solutions. - Help teams distinguish model access through Model Garden, purchasing through Google Cloud Marketplace, and direct OpenAI offerings. Complex deal leadership and execution - Lead technical strategy for complex enterprise engagements, from use-case discovery and architecture design to prototyping, evaluation, and production deployment. - Resolve integration and operational blockers with OpenAI and Google Cloud counterparts, giving account teams clear decisions and next steps. - Validate model and feature availability, regional requirements, access controls, data handling, quotas, and support boundaries for each workload. - Prioritize opportunities and allocate technical resources according to customer impact and the potential to scale through the ecosystem. Solution architecture and hands-on building - Design and build OpenAI-powered applications that integrate with Google Cloud services, including Cloud Run or Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud Storage, and BigQuery where appropriate. - Develop reference implementations for supported Model Garden access to OpenAI through the Responses API, alongside direct OpenAI integration patterns where those better meet customer requirements. - Use the Vertex AI SDK for Python / Agent Platform SDK to discover deployable Model Garden models, inspect deployment configurations, and deploy supported open models to endpoints. Validate project, region, machine and accelerator choices, credentials, permissions, and test inference; distinguish this workflow from managed model API access. - Maintain supported SDK dependencies and adapt examples as Google updates its SDKs. Use Google Gen AI SDK for Google generative-AI capabilities migrated out of legacy Vertex AI modules, and the documented OpenAI API or SDK for OpenAI integration paths. - Build retrieval-augmented generation and tool-using workflows, connecting approved enterprise data and services with clear authorization boundaries. - Establish evaluation, observability, CI/CD, and operational practices that address output quality, safety, reliability, latency, and cost. - Make identity, networking, secrets management, and data governance explicit in architectures rather than assuming controls transfer between services or providers. Ecosystem enablement and scale - Create workshops, demos, playbooks, and reference architectures that Google Cloud teams and systems integrators can use independently. - Teach partner engineers how to evaluate model choices in Model Garden and select deployment approaches based on customer needs. - Pair with field teams on early deployments, then transfer delivery ownership as patterns mature. - Scale through global and regional systems integrators and independent software vendors, maintaining reusable assets as integrations evolve. Cross-functional leadership and feedback - Work with Alliances, Product, Engineering, GTM, and Enablement to align technical priorities and execution. - Turn recurring customer and partner issues into evidence-backed product feedback and specific requests. - Maintain clear guidance on validated capabilities, preview limitations, and unresolved gaps, and follow decisions back to the field. YOU'LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Have substantial technical consulting or equivalent experience, including relationships with senior technical and business leaders in complex organizations. - Have hands-on experience with Model Garden and the Vertex AI SDK for Python / Agent Platform SDK, including programmatic model discovery, deployment configuration, endpoint deployment, and inference testing. Understand how this tooling differs from Google Gen AI SDK and OpenAI API/SDK integration paths. - Can build production applications using Python or another relevant language, APIs, containers, and cloud services. - Have practical experience with LLM evaluation, retrieval, tool use, and secure enterprise integration. - Balance hands-on delivery with strategic influence, know when to go deep and when to enable others, and build trust with engineers, architects, and execu

jobs.jd: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. These include client engagement analytics, scalable and custom analytics for financial institutions, fraud analytics consulting, and solution integrity and enablement for production-ready platforms. We are looking for an Expert Data Scientist to help develop analytics and AI solutions for financial services, e-commerce, and other data-rich digital businesses. You will combine data science fundamentals with exploration and experimentation. You will work across Analytics, Product, and Engineering to identify opportunities, shape the data strategy needed to support them, develop and evaluate new approaches, and help move promising concepts from idea to prototype. This is an individual contributor position and you will report into the Sr. Manager of Fraud Analytics What You'll Do Apply advanced statistical, machine-learning, and analytical techniques to complex business problems. Translate ambiguous business problems into structured hypotheses, experiments, models, and prototypes. Identify new opportunities where data science and new AI technologies can create value. Help shape data strategy for new analytics and AI capabilities by identifying the data, derived features, and data assets needed to support experimentation, development, and scalable solutions. Prototype and evaluate new approaches, comparing them with existing methods and identifying both strengths and failure modes. Develop evaluation criteria covering model or solution quality, reliability, value, operational practicality, and risk. Partner with Product, Engineering, and business teams to move promising analytical concepts toward practical applications. Stay current with new technologies, including generative and agentic AI, and evaluate their applicability to business problems. Share insights, mentor junior members of the team and help build a culture of experimentation, innovation, and learning. Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 5+ years of professional experience in data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or advanced analytics consistent with a senior-level role. Hands-on programming experience with Python and SQL. Experience developing and evaluating statistical or machine-learning solutions using large datasets. Experience translating business problems into analytical solutions, models, proofs of concept, or prototypes. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on. 1. Client projects Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs. Improving our scoring systems Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost. jobs.jd: A little about us…Fleetio is a modern software platform that helps thousands of organizations worldwide manage their fleet operations. Transportation technology is a hot market, and we’re leading the charge with raving fans and new customers signing up every day. We raised $450M in our Series D funding round in March of 2025 and are on an exciting trajectory as a company. Fleetio is also a proud founding member of the Rails Foundation ! More about our team and company: Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YoXyXTFWbkg Our careers page: https://www.fleetio.com/careers Fleetio is looking for a product-minded Senior Applied Data Scientist to join our Fleet Intelligence team. You will help turn years of fleet maintenance and operational data into trusted, actionable intelligence that helps customers anticipate what is ahead and make better decisions about usage, cost, availability, maintenance risk, and asset lifecycle. This is an applied role at the intersection of data science, machine learning, analytics engineering, and product development. You will work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Software Engineers, and Data partners to identify valuable prediction problems, develop practical models, and bring them into customer-facing workflows. Your goal is to deliver intelligence that changes a decision, arrives early enough to act on, and communicates uncertainty honestly. Your initial mandate will be grounded in confirmed Fleet Intelligence work: utilization and tire intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytics foundations needed to support customer-facing intelligence. You will assess current model quality, establish credible baselines, and help the team ship useful capabilities while strengthening its data-science practices. Over time, you will help evaluate and shape opportunities for Predictive Fleet Intelligence, including projection, anticipation, and risk inference. You will help determine which opportunities are technically credible, valuable to customers, and ready to become durable product investments. More About Our Team and Company Watch our culture videos: https://fleet.io/culture Engineering culture, interview process, and videos: https://www.fleetio.com/careers/engineering Fleetio overview video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IlvIbwZT3oU More about the Fleetio platform: https://www.fleetio.com/features API docs: https://developer.fleetio.com This is a remote opportunity and is open to candidates in the United States, Canada, or Mexico. Who You Are You are an applied data scientist who enjoys working on ambiguous, high-value product problems. You can translate a customer or business decision into a measurable modeling problem, establish a credible baseline, and iteratively improve it. You know when straightforward statistics or deterministic projection is the right answer and when a machine learning approach is warranted. You care deeply about correctness, explainability, and trust. You are comfortable communicating confidence intervals, limitations, and data gaps to technical and non-technical partners. You collaborate well with software and data engineers, but you can independently explore data, build production-quality models, define evaluation methods, and guide how model outputs should appear in a product experience. You are pragmatic, product-minded, and outcome-oriented. You would rather ship a useful, well-calibrated forecast than an impressive model that does not change a customer decision. Your Impact Help deliver near-term Fleet Intelligence initiatives, including tire intelligence, utilization intelligence, ROI measurement, existing predictive models, and the analytical foundations that support customer-facing intelligence. Evaluate and develop credible projections or predictive models for fleet usage, maintenance cost, availability, condition and failure risk, and asset lifecycle decisions as product direction and evidence mature. Translate product questions into clear hypotheses, target variables, baselines, evaluation plans, and incremental delivery milestones. Explore Fleetio’s maintenance, usage, cost, work-order, telematics, warranty, and asset-history data to identify predictive signals and material data gaps. Build, validate, and operationalize models from experimentation through production monitoring and iteration. Define model-quality metrics, confidence thresholds, drift detection, and feedback loops appropriate to the cost and reversibility of the customer decision. Partner with Product and Design to make model outputs understandable, explainable, and actionable inside the workflows where customers already make decisions. Establish reusable practices for experimentation, model documentation, validation, monitoring, and responsible claims about predictive performance. Communicate findings, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical partners, product leaders, and executives. Share knowledge through design reviews, documentation, pairing, and mentorship across Fleet Intelligence and adjacent teams. Your Experience 5+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, statistical modeling, or a closely related role. jobs.title: Data Scientist, CloudTune
jobs.jd: Amazon's eCommerce Foundation (eCF) organization provides the core technologies that drive and power Amazon's Stores, Digital, and Other (SDO) businesses. Millions of customer page views and orders per day are enabled by the systems eCF builds from the ground up. CloudTune, within eCF, empowers growth and business agility needs by automatically and efficiently managing AWS capacity and business processes needed to safely meet Amazon's customer demand. CloudTune serves its primary customers, internal software teams, through forecast-driven automation of cost controllership, capacity management, and scaling. We predict expected load, and drive procurement and allocation of AWS capacity for new product launches and high-velocity events like Prime Day and Cyber Monday. CloudTune is looking for a Data Scientist to join our forecasting and optimization team. The team develops sophisticated algorithms that combine machine learning-based demand forecasting with mathematical optimization to solve large-scale capacity planning problems under uncertainty. We work with massive datasets — spanning thousands of availability zone and instance family combinations across global regions — to determine optimal resource allocation strategies that balance infrastructure holding costs against service availability requirements. These models directly inform multi-million dollar capacity investment decisions and drive automated procurement, retention, and release policies across Amazon's compute infrastructure. As a Data Scientist in CloudTune, you will work with other scientists, software engineers, data engineers, and product managers on a variety of important research problems in the areas of stochastic optimization, time series modeling, and operations research. You will work on statistical problems with a high level of ambiguity. You will analyze and process large amounts of data, develop new algorithms and improve existing approaches based on statistical models, machine learning algorithms and big data solutions to automatically scale Amazon’s compute infrastructure, optimizing the balance between availability risk and cost efficiency for all of Amazon businesses. Key job responsibilities - Process and analyze large data sets, mining additional data sources as needed - Build statistical models and drive scalable solutions for multi-year capacity demand forecasting horizons - Create, enhance, and maintain technical documentation, and present to other scientists and business leaders - Process and analyze large-scale operational data to identify patterns and inform model development - Create, enhance, and maintain technical documentation, and present research findings to scientists, engineering teams, and senior leadership - 1+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 2+ years of data/research scientist, statistician or quantitative analyst in an internet-based company with complex and big data sources experience - 1+ years of creating or contributing to mathematical textbooks, research papers, or educational content experience - Master's degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM), or experience working in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) - Ph.D. in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) - Knowledge of statistical packages and business intelligence tools such as SPSS, SAS, S-PLUS, or R - Knowledge of machine learning concepts and their application to reasoning and problem-solving - Experience with clustered data processing (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Map-reduce, and Hive) - Experience working with or evaluating AI systems - Experience applying quantitative analysis to solve business problems and making data-driven business decisions - Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.jd: The Role Moveworks' AI agents don't just generate text — they act. They plan, call tools, and change real state in enterprise systems on behalf of 5.5 million employees. Building agents is no longer the bottleneck. Improving them is: knowing whether a change made the agent better, why a conversation failed, and which part of the system should be fixed. You'll build the loop that makes our agents improve themselves — finding failures in real use, deciding which part of the agent harness is responsible, checking every proposed fix on cases the fixer never saw, and turning each fixed failure into a permanent test. We improve the system around the model: instructions, tool descriptions, routing, knowledge and memory. We don't train the model itself. The work is blend of ML and systems engineering. You'll decide whether a signal is trustworthy enough to act on, and build the infrastructure that produces that signal reproducibly across hundreds of customer organizations. This isn't a model-training role, and it isn't a testing role. It's applied ML at a point where the methodology genuinely isn't settled: LLMs judging LLMs is an open research problem, and we're working it against agents that take real, irreversible actions in stateful, multi-tenant enterprise environments. What you get to do in this role: Judge design and calibration A shared base judge with per-item rubrics expressed as configuration next to the dataset — so eval authors express intent, rather than forking a prompt per eval Splitting the problem correctly: deterministic validators for checkable world state ("was the ticket created, with the right item, routed to the right approver?"), and an LLM judge for the parts that are genuinely fuzzy — was the clarifying question appropriate, was policy followed, was the path efficient Scoring that reports its own confidence , so uncertain judgements route to a human instead of quietly becoming trusted signal A standing calibration loop against human-labeled trajectories, run in partnership with our annotation team — they own the human labeling, you own the calibrated judge artifact. How consistently humans agree with each other sets the ceiling on how good any judge can be, so raising that ceiling is part of the job Guarding against correlated blind spots: our user simulator and our judge are both LLMs, and they can be wrong in the same direction Offline↔online divergence: when simulation and production disagree, being the person who can say why, and keeping the suite re-seeded from new production failures so it can't quietly overfit Self-improving agent harness This is where the pillar is headed, and a large part of why the seat exists. You'll build the components that let the agent harness get better from its own use, without changing the model underneath. Finding what to improve: surfacing where the agent falls short in real use, including failures that look like success Synthetic data and environments: generating scenarios and the seeded enterprise worlds they run in — with expected outcomes and checks — from real failures or ahead of what customers ask for, and making sure what gets generated is realistic, hard enough, and doesn't leak the answer Deciding where a fix belongs: understanding why the agent failed and which part of the harness should change: its instructions, tools, routing, knowledge or memory Proposing improvements: optimizing those components against simulation rather than against production traffic Checking before anything ships: verifying every proposed change on cases it wasn't tuned on, catching regressions an average would hide, and keeping the part that proposes a change separate from the part that judges it Evals that grow: every fixed failure becomes a permanent test, so the suite gets stronger the more the agent is used Safe across many customers: learnings stay scoped to one organization where they must, and admins approve anything org-specific The infrastructure that runs it: a loop that runs reproducibly, at scale, across hundreds of customer organizations The guardrail that keeps it honest: end-state outcomes are what we hold the agent to To be successful in this role you have: 2+ years in applied ML, data science, or ML-adjacent engineering, with a track record of work that shipped and got used Experience turning subjective human judgement into a measurement that holds up — one that other people, and ideally other models, can act on. This is the core of the job Strong applied ML fundamentals, and comfort treating LLMs as a component you evaluate, prompt, and fine-tune rather than one you pretrain Strong Python, and the discipline to ship production-grade code rather than notebooks Ability to think and communicate clearly about complex problems — a large part of this job is convincing engineers that a number means what you say it means, and being right A high degree of ownership and a bias toward shipping at startup pace Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgement to know when a measurement is good enough to act on Experience in at least 3 of these: LLM-as-judge or automated evaluation design, and calibrating it against human judgement Human annotation programs: rubric authoring, label quality, and annotator throughput as a real constraint Search ranking, recsys, or online experimentation evaluation — golden-set staleness, offline/online divergence, side-by-side rater agreement. This is the closest existing analog to agentic eval, and it transfers directly Fine-tuning and evaluating small models: SFT, preference tuning, distillation Reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF, or process reward models Agent trajectory analysis and step-level fault attribution Prompt engineering as an engineering discipline — versioned, tested, and measured, not tuned by vibes For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $161,300 - $274,200, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. jobs.title: Threat Research Engineer, Security Factory: Threat Research
jobs.location: Remote, Israel; Remote, Poland; Remote, United Kingdom
jobs.jd:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Threat Research Engineer, you’ll take ideas from the first question to a working proof of concept, deploy it, and analyze the results yourself. This is a full-stack role, with AI central to how we work. You’ll build agentic workflows for research, analysis, and detection, and use AI tools every day to move faster.

What you’ll do

  • Research new attack surfaces and threat vectors, including AI coding agents, agent plugins, and package ecosystems.
  • Find and responsibly disclose vulnerabilities in open source projects and developer tools.
  • Analyze software supply chain incidents and events.
  • Build AI-powered workflows and agents that automate research, analysis, and detection.
  • Build and maintain the cloud-based systems behind our detection and advisory work.
  • Improve the quality and coverage of our vulnerability and malware advisories.
  • Write up your findings as blog posts and present them at conferences.
  • Take part in on-call or operational support where your team's ownership model requires it.

What you’ll bring

  • Hands-on security experience in research, malware analysis, penetration testing, or security tooling, with both a developer mindset and an adversarial mindset: you can build systems and think about how to break them.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI in real work, such as building with large language model APIs or agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or agent SDKs.
  • Strong programming skills in Go or Python, with good software engineering practices including testing, code review, continuous integration and continuous delivery, and maintainable code.
  • Experience deploying and running production services on a public cloud.
  • Understanding of how package ecosystems work and how software supply chain attacks happen.
  • Ability to map possible attack vectors, name trade-offs, and make data-driven decisions, balancing quality and speed with customer outcomes in mind while keeping up with security and AI industry trends.
  • Clear writing that explains findings to both engineers and a general audience.
  • Helpful, but not required: published vulnerability findings; security research on AI agents, large language model applications, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers; Google Cloud Platform experience; or infrastructure as code experience with Terraform or OpenTofu.

You don’t need deep knowledge of compilers or static application security testing engines. A high-level understanding is enough.

About the team

The Threat Research group researches security threats as they emerge and turns what we learn into protection for GitLab customers. We maintain the GitLab Advisory Database, which powers GitLab’s dependency scanning. We also build detection capabilities, do original vulnerability research, and publish what we find. Recent work includes the Shai-Hulud npm worm and a critical remote code execution vulnerability in Serena, a popular MCP coding agent. You can read more on the Security Labs blog.

jobs.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
jobs.jd: About the Role Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach. We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting. Why this is interesting Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments. An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users. Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan. Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation. What You'll Do Bring global flood models to the local scale Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about. Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally. Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation. Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production. Work as one modelling team Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs. Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models. Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance. Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers. Stay close to the real world We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand. You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions. Who You Are You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use. You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers. You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information. You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment. You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations. Technical Requirements MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, or atmospheric sciences . Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient. Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins. Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data. Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty. Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments. Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework. Nice to Have Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction. Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets. Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling. Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr. Previous early startup experience. Role Details Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE). Start date: immediately Reports to : CTO. Compensation : Commensurate with experience + equity Growth : a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows. Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home. Work authorisation : Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required. Working language: English. German is not required. About Riverkin We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.jd: At ExtraHop, we’re on a mission to protect and empower the connected enterprise. We reveal what is happening in the very infrastructure that sustains businesses, lives, and communities, and ensure the integrity of networks, data, systems, and processes. Organizations rely on ExtraHop to provide visibility into the cyber threats, vulnerabilities, and network performance issues that evade their existing security and IT tools. With this insight, organizations can investigate smarter, stop threats faster, and keep operations running. Our mission is fueled by a profound social and moral responsibility to be the best at what we do, ensuring a secure world where everyone can thrive. If this sounds like a place you’d like to spend the next chapter of your career, we’d love to hear from you. Position Summary ExtraHop is at the forefront of cybersecurity innovation, delivering Network Detection and Response (NDR) solutions that help organizations detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats in real time. Join ExtraHop as a Senior Data Scientist and help advance the machine learning and artificial intelligence capabilities that power our products. You will analyze large-scale network telemetry, develop and evaluate methods for identifying malicious behavior, and improve the accuracy and efficacy of ExtraHop’s threat detection capabilities. This is an applied data science role for someone who enjoys solving ambiguous, high-impact problems using statistical analysis, experimentation, and machine learning. You will work closely with other data scientists, threat researchers, and software engineers to translate research into reliable product capabilities, and play a key role in contributing to the improvement of the RevealX platform. Key Responsibilities Analyze large-scale network telemetry to identify behavioral patterns, anomalies, and signals associated with malicious activity. Design, develop, and refine machine learning and AI-based methods that support ExtraHop’s products. Develop evaluation methods appropriate for cybersecurity data, including highly imbalanced datasets, incomplete labels, rare events, and changing attacker and network behavior. Conduct exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, model development, and error analysis using complex, high-volume datasets. Research emerging machine learning and AI techniques, relevant cybersecurity developments, and assess their applicability to ExtraHop’s products. Establish metrics and monitoring strategies for measuring model and detector performance over time. Communicate findings, limitations, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical stakeholders and product leaders. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other data scientists through code reviews, design discussions, technical strategy, and contributions to the team’s analytical and engineering standards. Document methodologies, experiments, model behavior, and evaluation results. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested production-quality code. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 7+ years of professional experience in data science, including developing and evaluating machine learning models for real-world use cases, defining meaningful success metrics, and conducting rigorous offline and online evaluations. Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, machine learning, and model evaluation. Experience working with incomplete, noisy, or highly imbalanced data; performing detailed error analysis; and identifying the causes of false positives and false negatives. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, experience with common data science and machine learning libraries, and the ability to write maintainable, tested, and reviewable code. Experience collaborating with software engineers to integrate data science methods into production systems. Strong problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and a track record of independently owning complex technical work. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to varied audiences. Preferred Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or another quantitative discipline. Experience applying data science or machine learning to cybersecurity, fraud detection, abuse detection, anomaly detection, or another adversarial domain. Familiarity with Network Detection and Response, network protocols, threat detection, or incident investigation. Experience with time-series analysis, anomaly detection, actuarial modeling, clustering, graph analytics, or unsupervised and semi-supervised learning. Experience evaluating models in domains where positive examples are rare, labels are incomplete, and the underlying behavior changes over time. Experience with generative AI, large language models, agentic systems, or other emerging AI techniques. Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP. The salary range for this role is $165,000 - $180,000 + bonus + benefits ABOUT EXTRAHOP ExtraHop is reinventing Network Detection and Response (NDR) to offer enterprises unparalleled visibility, context, and control against emerging threats. The platform integrates NDR with Network Performance Management (NPM), Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and forensics, providing a single, comprehensive solution. By decrypting and analyzing complete packet-level data at wire speed and leveraging cloud-scale machine learning, ExtraHop empowers Security Operations Centers (SOCs) to detect, investigate, and remediate modern cyber risks in real time across their entire hybrid infrastructure, including data center, cloud, and SASE environments. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. Build where the work happens As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you work side by side with the people who run our trade: sales, procurement, logistics, finance and customer success. You find where time and money go into manual work, and you build the agents, automations and tools that take it over. Much of Andercore's daily work still happens in calls, emails, spreadsheets and PDFs. Our AI agents already schedule deliveries and request freight quotes; there is much more to do. You sit with the teams, understand their work in detail, ship a first version in days, and make it reliable enough that they trust it with real orders. You work closely with our product engineers and the CPO. What works for one team, you turn into reusable skills and components the whole company can use, and you help our colleagues build with AI themselves. What you will do Embed with the business: Spend real time with our commercial and operations teams and map how the work actually gets done. Find the steps that cost the most time, money or mistakes. Build and ship fast: Build agents, automations, internal tools and data flows, with a first version in days, not months. Bring what works into production together with our product engineers. Make agents reliable: Add evaluations, guardrails and human review where money or customers are involved. Monitor what you shipped and fix what breaks. Scale what works: Turn one-off solutions into reusable skills, knowledge bases and components. Help colleagues build with AI themselves. Close the loop: Measure impact: hours saved, error rates, speed and margin. Feed what you learn into the product roadmap. Be the bridge: Translate between the business and engineering. Write down decisions and trade-offs so others can build on them. What success looks like Clear, measured time savings in the teams you work with Agents our colleagues trust with real orders Reusable skills and tools adopted across the company Business teams who build small automations themselves The best ideas from the field turned into product work Fewer errors in the steps you automated What you bring At least 3 years of experience building and shipping software, ideally in Python or TypeScript. Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks, and good judgment about where they work and where they don't. You enjoy working with non-technical colleagues: you ask good questions, listen, and explain things simply. Product sense: you turn a vague problem into a clear first version and improve it with real feedback. Solid data skills, including SQL, and comfort with messy real-world data such as emails, PDFs and spreadsheets. Speed with judgment: you ship quickly and know when something needs to be done properly. Experience in a startup or scale-up. Interest in trade, supply chain or B2B commerce is a plus. Fluent English. German is a plus. jobs.jd: At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running. Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. Supported by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software. WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS Als Forward Deployed Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass remberg bei unseren Kunden zum Herzstück der Instandhaltung wird. Du arbeitest hands-on zwischen Prospects, Kunden, Product und Engineering. Du verbindest remberg mit SAP und anderen ERP-Systemen, bringst Sensor- und Maschinendaten auf die Plattform und gibst der remberg KI den Kontext, den sie braucht, um in der Industrie echten Mehrwert zu liefern. Du baust, was Kund:innen brauchen, bringst es schnell live und lässt deine Learnings direkt ins Produkt einfließen. Als erster FDE bei remberg gestaltest du die Rolle von Grund auf und baust die ersten Playbooks. Du berichtest direkt an Julian Borg, unseren Co-Founder und CPO, und arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Go-to-Market sowie Product und Engineering zusammen. Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Office in München und bist im Schnitt ein paar Tage im Monat bei Kunden vor Ort. THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE SAP/ERP-Integration: Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen remberg und SAP (z. B. SAP PM/MM, S/4HANA, ECC) oder anderen ERP-Systemen. Dabei begleitest du sie vom technischen Scoping über das Data Mapping bis zum stabilen Betrieb nach dem Go-live. Kundenkommunikation: Für Instandhaltung, Operations und IT bist du die technische Ansprechperson, vor Ort und remote. Du übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass alle mitkommen. Bei Kundencalls und Sales Deals in der späten Phase bist du dabei, schätzt Machbarkeit und Aufwand ein und beantwortest IT- und Security-Fragen. Sensor-Integration: Du bindest Maschinen- und Sensordaten (z. B. über IoT-Plattformen, OPC UA, MQTT oder Kunden-APIs) an remberg an und ermöglichst so zustandsbasierte Instandhaltung und automatisch ausgelöste Aufträge. AI Context Engineering: Du bereitest Kundendaten, Dokumente und Instandhaltungswissen so auf, dass die remberg KI präzise und verlässliche Antworten liefert. Gemeinsam mit Kunden prüfst du die Ergebnisse und verbesserst den Kontext Schritt für Schritt. Product-Feedback-Loop: Wenn mehrere Kunden vor derselben Herausforderung stehen, machst du mit Product und Engineering aus der Einzellösung ein Feature für alle. Du baust wiederverwendbare Integrationspakete und schreibst Playbooks, mit denen AEs und CSMs Standardfragen selbst beantworten können. HOW YOU'LL GROW WITH US Erfahrung: 3+ Jahre in Software Engineering, Solutions oder Integration Engineering, technischer Beratung, Product Management oder ähnlichen Rollen, idealerweise im B2B-Software-, Industrie- oder Fertigungsumfeld. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst sicher mit Stakeholdern vom Shopfloor über die IT bis zum Management, gehst Probleme strukturiert an und willst Dinge shippen. Integrations-Know-how: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit APIs (REST, OData), Data Mapping und Enterprise-Systemen. Erfahrung mit SAP oder anderen ERP-Systemen ist ein großes Plus. Industriedaten & IoT: Du kennst dich mit Sensordaten, IoT-Plattformen oder Industrieprotokollen (z. B. OPC UA, MQTT) aus oder hast richtig Lust, dich einzuarbeiten. Engineering Skills: Solide Programmierkenntnisse (z. B. Python oder TypeScript) und SQL sowie praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Mobilität: Du bist bereit, im Schnitt ein paar Tage pro Monat zu Kunden zu reisen. Zudem hast du einen Führerschein, damit du dabei flexibel bist. Sprachen: Fließendes Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1) in Wort und Schrift. EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO THRIVE 💰 Competitive compensation package : Enjoy a salary, benefits, and equity*, with annual reviews. 💻 State-of-the-art tools and equipment for a modern and efficient setup. 🍏 Health and wellness benefits : Access to Nilo Health, JobRad*, and your choice between a GUUD card or Wellpass / Urban Sports Club for sports and fitness. 🥨 Prime office location & culture : Our office is in the heart of Munich, near the main train station, making it easily accessible for commuters and travelers. Our office is always lively, with 3 days/week in the office. 🌞 Work-from-anywhere flexibility : You can work remotely for up to 3 months per year. 🌴 Attractive Compensation & Benefits : In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy different company benefits and 30 vacation days*. 📚 Continuous learning : Get a €1,500 development budget plus 1 day of educational leave per year.* 🤝 Volunteering day : 1 paid day per year to give back to a cause you care about. *Some perks apply to permanent full-time employees only. ABOUT US remberg is a fast-growing start-up based in Munich. Founded in 2018 as a spin-off from TU Munich & CDTM. We help industrial companies to keep the physical world running by simplifying maintenance with modern, agentic software. Today, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. With ~28 M € capital raised by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software (CMMS/EAM). jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Agent)
jobs.jd: Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day. Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu , founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences. Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta. About the role: At Cresta, the AI Agent team is on a mission to create state-of-the-art AI Agents that solve practical problems for our customers. We are focused on leveraging the latest technologies in Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent systems, while ensuring that the solutions we develop are cost-effective, secure, and reliable. As an AI Agent Engineer , you'll be at the forefront of deploying AI agents that address real-world challenges. In this role, you will work closely with customers as well as our software and machine learning engineers, ensuring high-impact AI Agent deployments and contributing to the continuous improvement of our core AI platform. You’ll develop intelligent AI agents, integrate them seamlessly with external systems and offer hands-on technical expertise to ensure successful deployments.. This position requires strong engineering skills, adaptability, and customer engagement. If you are self-driven, analytical, and eager to leverage AI in practical applications, this role is for you. What You'll Do : AI Agent Development: Develop, configure, deploy, and optimize AI agents using Cresta’s AI platform and tools. System Integration: Build AI agent integrations with external systems (APIs, databases, CRMs, etc.) to ensure seamless workflow integration. Performance Optimization: Optimize AI agent performance (e.g. fine-tune prompts and configurations) and troubleshoot issues in complex enterprise environments. Requirements Gathering: Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to gather technical requirements and translate business needs into AI Agent solutions. Demos & Iteration: Conduct interactive demos and present compelling proof-of-concepts to prospective customers, proactively gather feedback, and iteratively refine solutions to meet objectives. Project Coordination: Define project milestones, create implementation plans, and coordinate execution with internal teams to ensure on-time delivery. Provide a tight feedback loop to our product and engineering teams — identifying gaps, building custom tooling, and influencing the roadmap through real-world deployment learnings. Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with PMs to define agent goals, iterate rapidly based on customer feedback, and shape product capabilities that maximize customer ROI. Technical Guidance: Serve as a trusted technical advisor for the customer, guiding best practices for AI agent adoption and usage. Provide technical guidance on AI agent best practices, including architecture design, security considerations, and scalability planning. What We're Looking For: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Experience: 3+ years of full-time working experience in software development/Consulting, AI/ML engineering, or Forward Deployed Engineering. Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python and Golang, with the ability to write clean, efficient code. AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts. Hands-on experience with large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering techniques are strongly preferred. AI Agent Frameworks: Strong understanding of general AI agent frameworks, function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Hands-on experience of building such a system is strongly preferred. Cloud & DevOps: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and DevOps practices (CI/CD, containerization, monitoring). Integration Expertise: Hands-on experience with integrating systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines. Communication: Excellent communication and project management skills. Analytical Approach: Ability to use data-driven decision-making, including A/B testing and performance monitoring, to refine solutions. Collaborative Builder: You thrive in cross-functional environments, working hand-in-hand with PMs and engineers to turn real customer problems into scalable AI solutions. Note on Our Hiring Process We highly value your time and engineering craftsmanship. To ensure a streamlined and objective process, the first step for qualified applicants following an initial resume review is a self-paced CoderPad technical assessment. This allows you to showcase your practical coding and problem-solving skills in a real-world environment before moving into conversational interview rounds. jobs.title: Data Scientist II - Amazon Identity Program , Amazon Identity Program (AIP)
jobs.jd: Amazon Advertising is seeking a Data Scientist II to help measure and improve one of the world's largest advertising identity platforms. You will work with massive datasets to uncover insights that directly influence how Amazon recognizes customers, connects identity signals, and enables advertisers to reach and measure audiences across the global advertising ecosystem. The Amazon Advertising Identity Platform (AIP) powers identity resolution across Amazon's owned and operated properties, third party publishers, and the open internet. As traditional identity signals become less available and consumer behavior spans more devices and environments, understanding the accuracy, coverage, and business impact of identity resolution has become increasingly important. As a Data Scientist II, you will develop analytical frameworks, measurement methodologies, and data driven insights to evaluate the performance of Amazon's identity graph. You will work with billions of identity signals to quantify recognition rates, graph coverage, identity accuracy, and the incremental value of deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution. Your analysis will help identify opportunities to improve advertising addressability, audience reach, campaign measurement, and revenue. You will design experiments, develop statistical models, and establish measurement frameworks to understand how identity improvements translate into better advertising outcomes. This includes evaluating the precision and recall of identity models, measuring the incremental contribution of individual identity sources, identifying gaps in identity coverage, and quantifying the commercial impact of identity investments. You will partner closely with applied scientists, software engineers, product managers, and business leaders to translate complex data into actionable recommendations. Your work will help shape technical priorities, guide investment decisions, and establish the metrics used to evaluate identity performance across Amazon Advertising. The ideal candidate has strong expertise in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, experimentation, and large scale data analytics. You should be comfortable working with complex datasets, developing rigorous measurement methodologies, and communicating findings to both technical and business audiences. This role offers the opportunity to establish how Amazon measures identity quality and business impact, influence the direction of a critical advertising platform, and apply data science to problems operating at global scale. - 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience - 2+ years of data scientist experience - 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience - Bachelor's degree - Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment - Experience in Python, Perl, or another scripting language - Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Agentic Systems Engineer (Digital Services)
jobs.jd:
Overview

We're looking for an Agentic Systems Engineer, to work on systems that haven't existed before. Think of an Agentic Coach that navigates the unpredictability of human biology, or the software architecture behind a fully automated Dark Lab. These aren't chatbots waiting for questions. They're proactive systems that maintain world models, interpret human intent, and intervene before the user knows to ask. These systems create genuine impact for clients tackling complex problems at the forefront of technology.

Building them means designing and wiring agent harnesses: layered architectures that span from sensor-edge reasoning to high-level planning, backed by stateful multi-turn reasoning, persistent per-user memory, and robust evaluation pipelines.

You'll work in two directions at once. Internally, you'll use the latest AI tools to sharpen how we build, prototype, and ship. Externally, you'll deliver the breakthrough systems our clients deploy, designed to move from prototype to production at pace.

There's no single technology stack. You'll work with agents, multi-agent systems, and the latest generative AI tools, but your work will always be grounded in solid software engineering. Expect to build scalable distributed systems in core languages like Python and TypeScript, leveraging frameworks such as NextJS and Pydantic, agent orchestration tools (LangGraph, CrewAI), and protocols like MCP. You'll deploy on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) using Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code, backed by rigorous CI/CD and observability (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus).

Due to the clients we work with, you must be eligible for UK security clearance.

What you'll be doing:

  • AI System Architecture: Designing and implementing the logic for autonomous systems, including maintaining world models, integrating multimodal sensing, and building real-time human-machine interaction loops.
  • Infrastructure & Production Engineering: Designing the underlying software for scalable, secure, and observable cloud deployments. You will apply the engineering rigor required to take experimental AI from concept to robust live launch.
  • Rapid Client Prototyping: Driving a demo-first delivery model. You will focus on fast experimentation to actively show tangible value and working software to clients, while maintaining the engineering standards required for production deployment.
  • Domain Translation & Integration: Partnering directly with deep-tech subject matter experts (like biologists and roboticists) to apply software solutions to complex physical constraints.
  • Agent Evaluation & Optimisation: Developing frameworks to measure, monitor and improve agent performance. You will design evaluation strategies, identify failure modes, and apply systematic testing to ensure agents are reliable, predictable and effective in real-world environments.

What you need to succeed:

  • Applied AI Expertise: You have hands-on experience building LLM-based agentic systems, with a solid grasp of the fundamentals: planning, reasoning, tool use, memory and orchestration. You know how to evaluate and monitor agents so you can measure how they perform in production.
  • Core Software Fluency: You possess strong programming skills, good testing and deployment practices, and practical experience in cloud engineering, containerisation, and modern DevOps. You can design scalable, resilient systems, and you know that great agents still require excellent software engineering foundations.
  • Navigating Ambiguity: You are comfortable working with uncertainty and evolving requirements. You break complex, ill-defined problems into clear, logical steps. You recognise that requirements evolve as new information emerges and can make sound engineering judgements about when rapid experimentation is appropriate and when a more rigorous approach is required.
  • Communication: You communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently, adapting your style to different audiences. You are comfortable engaging with clients, engineers, scientists and business leaders, ensuring technical insights translate into meaningful decisions and outcomes.
  • Collaboration and Influence: You know how to challenge constructively, influence through evidence and insight, and help others navigate trade-offs in fast-moving environments.
  • Problem Solving: You enjoy tackling complex technical challenges and can quickly distil ambiguity into actionable plans. You combine analytical thinking with pragmatism to identify the right solution and move projects forward.

Some projects at Cambridge Consultants are subject to security restrictions. This role requires you to obtain a Security Check (SC) level security clearance  ( United Kingdom Security Vetting: Applicant ). You must be able to work in the UK without restrictions in accordance with UK National Law and be prepared to successfully undertake an appropriate level of UK National Security Vetting according to UK Government National Security Vetting criteria. Please be aware that, for roles requiring Security Check clearance, applicants will typically need to have been continuously resident in the UK for a minimum of 5 years immediately prior to applying for this role in order to meet the requirements for Security Check (SC) clearance.

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays (with the option to buy 10 more a year)
  • Company bonus (profit share)
  • Flexible working patterns and hybrid working
  • Medical insurance and group income protection
  • Employee assistance programme and mental health support group
