jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Hardware Quality
jobs.jd: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. At Oura, our mission is to empower every person to own their inner potential. With our award-winning Oura Ring and app, we help millions of people turn insights about sleep, activity, and readiness into healthier, more balanced lives.We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Scientist to partner with Oura’s Hardware, Quality, Firmware, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Support Engineering, and Finance teams. This role will help build the data science and decision systems that make Oura hardware more reliable, from early product testing and launch readiness through field performance, warranty outcomes, and long-term product improvement.You will work on some of the most important problems in consumer hardware: understanding why products fail, predicting reliability before issues reach members, connecting manufacturing and testing data to field outcomes, and turning complex engineering data into clear decisions. jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.jd: Who are we? Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin ! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers. And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews. If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses. The Team You will be joining the Detection team. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low – and clients happy – by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible. Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs, every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why. The Detection team is core to Ravelin ’s success. They work closely with the Data Engineering Team who build infrastructure and the Intelligence & Investigations Team who liaise with clients. The Role We are currently looking for a Data Scientist to help train, deploy, debug and evaluate our fraud detection models. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures. Evaluating fraud models is hard; often times we do not even get labels for 3 months. You’ll need to use your judgement when investigating cases of ambiguous fraud and when you’re investigating the veracity of the model itself. We have to build robust models that are capable of updating their beliefs when they encounter new methods of fraud: our clients expect us to be one step ahead of fraud, not behind. You will be given the equipment, space and guidance you need to build world class fraud detection models. The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job – and understand why both are important. Key Responsibilities Build out our model evaluation and training infrastructure. Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs Write new features in our production infrastructure Research new techniques to disrupt fraudulent behaviour Investigate model performance issues (using your experience of debugging models). Requirements Around 1 year's experience building and deploying ML models using the Python data stack (numpy, pandas, sklearn or pytorch). Strong analytical skills. Being a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with client support teams or engineering. Being skilled at communicating complex technical ideas to a range of audiences. The ability to prioritise and to manage your workload. Being comfortable working with a hybrid team Benefits Flexible Working Hours & Remote-First Environment — Work when and where you’re most productive, with flexibility and support. Comprehensive BUPA Health Insurance — Stay covered with top-tier medical care for your peace of mind. £1,000 Annual Wellness and Learning Budget — Prioritise your health, well-being and learning needs with funds for fitness, mental health, and more. Monthly Wellbeing and Learning Day — Take every last Friday of the month off to recharge or learn something new, up to you. 25 Days Holiday + Bank Holidays + 1 Extra Cultural Day — Enjoy generous time off to rest, travel, or celebrate what matters to you. Mental Health Support via Spill — Access professional mental health services when you need them. Aviva Pension Scheme — Plan for the future with our pension program. Ravelin Gives Back — Join monthly charitable donations and volunteer opportunities to make a positive impact. Fortnightly Randomised Team Lunches — Connect with teammates from across the company over in person or remote lunches every other week on us! Cycle-to-Work Scheme — Save on commuting costs while staying active. BorrowMyDoggy Access — Love dogs? Spend time with a furry friend through this unique perk. Weekly Board Game Nights & Social Budget — Unwind with weekly board games or plan your own socials, supported by a company budget. *Job offers may be withdrawn if candidates do not meet our pre-employment checks: unspent criminal convictions, employment verification, and right to work.* Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.jd: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Title and Summary Lead AI Engineer Mastercard is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to join a small, focused AI technology team led by one of Mastercard's Distinguished Engineers. The team will initially focus on delivering agentic technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at scale and the use of open weight AI models. The team works in partnership with key technology stakeholders across the organization. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will design and build the platform capabilities that let Mastercard adopt MCP and open weight models safely and at scale, working alongside more senior engineers who set the broader technical direction. Job Description In this role, you will help build the platform patterns through which Mastercard teams expose tools and data to agents over MCP, and through which the enterprise serves, evaluates and governs open weight models. You will contribute to the key technical decisions — gateway and connectivity patterns, identity and access controls, model-serving infrastructure, and evaluation — and turn them into working, well-engineered, production-grade services. You will work across the MCP estate and the OW model working group, partnering closely with the team's senior engineers and with central technology, security and governance stakeholders. Key responsibilities: · Contribute to the design and build of the components of Mastercard's enterprise MCP deployment, such as the security gateway, the MCP registry that governs what exists and who owns it, and reference server implementations that teams build from. Take these from design through to running production services. · Implement the identity, authentication and authorization patterns for MCP across the estate, working with the team's senior engineers and central security and identity teams so that agents, tools and data are accessed securely and are auditable end to end. · Help set and apply the standard for internal and external MCP servers — how tools and data are exposed, discovered and versioned, and the inspection, data-protection, rate-limiting and kill-switch controls the gateway must enforce. · Build and operate open weight model serving — stand up and scale self-hosted inference, package models for deployment, and help enable switching workloads across models and providers for cost, flexibility and resilience. · Build the evaluation and testing tooling that benchmarks candidate open weight models for quality, cost, latency and safety, and produces the reproducible evidence that governance and security reviews need. · Apply the MLOps practices that keep the platform reliable — CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability, and model and service monitoring — so that what the team builds is maintainable and operable in production. · Partner with central security, privacy, legal and AI governance teams, and with the MCP SIG and OW working group, implementing their requirements correctly for the platform's architecture. · Keep current with a rapidly evolving landscape, such as new MCP developments, frontier open weight releases, and related agentic protocols, and help the team decide what to adopt, prototype, or wait on. All About You Skills, experience and attributes that would make you a strong candidate: · Strong knowledge of modern AI technology: LLMs and foundation models, agents, and the tooling and protocols (such as MCP) that connect them to enterprise systems. · Good software engineering skills: you write production-quality, well-tested code and build services others can depend on, not one-off scripts or prototypes. · Solid MLOps experience: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, containers, observability, and monitoring for models and services in production. · Good cloud platform knowledge (AWS preferred; Azure or GCP valuable). Familiarity with a modern data/AI platform such as Databricks a bonus. · Practical experience with model evaluation, including building benchmarks and tests that measure quality, cost, latency and safety, and producing reproducible results others can rely on. · Hands-on experience serving or operating open weight models, self-hosting and scaling inference, and ideally some fine-tuning or adaptation to proprietary data and workflows. · Working knowledge of API security, identity and access control, enough to implement MCP authentication and authorization correctly and partner effectively with security teams. · Awareness of the governance context that shapes enterprise AI, such as model provenance and licensing, data sovereignty, and financial-services regulation. · A clear communicator and collaborator who works well with senior engineers, hands-on peers, and specialist governance and security partner teams. · Intense curiosity about technology in general, and AI in particular, and who can demonstrate their learning agility outside the bounds of a specific function. · Lastly, a self-starter: once you have a clear guidance and direction, you don’t need to be hand-held to get to a solution or deliverable. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Platform - Moveworks
jobs.jd: The Role We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale. Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own. What you get to do in this role: Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge. Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates. Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains. Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production. To be successful in this role you have: You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas: Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub) Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation Required: 5+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems Strong in Python or Go (ideally both) Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions Relevant past experience: Building and shipping products on large language models with techniques such as RAG, chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool and function calling, and agentic reasoning. Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models on large datasets in production, especially for NLP, retrieval, or ranking. Improving relevance or quality through careful experimentation: designing metrics, building evaluation datasets, and developing new features and signals for ranking or model selection. Research or applied work in machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, information retrieval, or ranking and relevance. Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team We are hiring Sr ML Engineers across two teams. Admin Central is building the future of how administrators work across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience. Within Admin Central, Workday implementations move from being driven by human effort to being powered by intelligence designed into the platform. The Business Process Optimize (BPO) team powers the underlying platform infrastructure. You’ll build mission-critical distributed systems, high-availability usage pipelines, new agentic functionality, and event-driven data flows across global product regions to ensure enterprise billing integrity at scale. If you're excited to build from scratch, move fast, and transform how thousands of admins work every day, come join us! Note: VISA Sponsorship is not available for this role. Relocation support is not available for this role. About the Role Key Responsibilities ML Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines—from distributed data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Agentic AI & Recommendation Engines: Design algorithms and LLM-driven recommendation features (e.g., IDD insights, next-best-action models) that optimize agentic workflows and tool usage. Team Collaboration: Strong ability to mentor team members, drive cross-functional technical alignment, draft system design specs/model cards, and communicate technical and governance decisions. Education: Bachelor's in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or Engineering; Master's or PhD strongly preferred. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Sponsored Products and Brands
jobs.jd: Sponsored Products and Brands (SPB) helps millions of advertisers reach shoppers across Amazon's stores worldwide. Behind every ad we show are machine learning models that predict click-through rate (CTR) and conversion rate (CVR). These predictions decide which ads are relevant, how they rank, and how advertisers get value. Our team builds and runs the ML infrastructure behind those models, end to end: - Offline feature engineering: a multi-tenant platform used by several ML teams. It runs thousands of daily feature jobs over petabyte-scale data and produces the features that train models in every marketplace we serve. - Model training: the standard system that retrains CTR and CVR models every day. How fresh these models are directly affects advertiser results and Amazon's revenue. - Online feature store and feature retrieval: low-latency, high-throughput services that provide features when a model makes a prediction. These predictions feed the scores used in real-time ad ranking. - Next-generation research platform: a platform that uses AI agents to help scientists explore, test and launch new model ideas faster. As an SDE II, you'll design, build and run distributed systems that work at very large scale, both in offline batch processing and online serving. You'll work closely with applied scientists and engineers to make models fresher, help scientists try ideas faster, and keep the systems that support ads ranking reliable. Key job responsibilities - Design and develop ML infrastructure for advanced recommendation models, from training through real-time inference, that delivers highly relevant ads to shoppers worldwide - Improve the scalability, automation and efficiency of large-scale training and real-time inference systems - Work closely with applied scientists to optimize the performance of ML models and infrastructure, and take models from experimentation into production - Deliver ML solutions end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment and operations - Collaborate with engineers and scientists across the team to build systems that serve ads across all Amazon platforms and surfaces - Participate in design and code reviews and mentor peers A day in the life You might start the day checking the health of the overnight feature and training pipelines. Then you'd work with scientists on how to support a new model architecture, and spend the afternoon building a performance improvement for the online feature store. You'll ship often, see your work affect ads served around the world, and influence how ML infrastructure grows across the organization. About the team The Sponsored Products and Brands team at Amazon Ads is re-imagining the advertising landscape through industry leading generative AI technologies, revolutionizing how millions of customers discover products and engage with brands across Amazon.com and beyond. We are at the forefront of re-inventing advertising experiences, bridging human creativity with artificial intelligence to transform every aspect of the advertising lifecycle from ad creation and optimization to performance analysis and customer insights. We are a passionate group of innovators dedicated to developing responsible and intelligent AI technologies that balance the needs of advertisers, enhance the shopping experience, and strengthen the marketplace. If you're energized by solving complex challenges and pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI, join us in shaping the future of advertising. We're the team behind the full ML lifecycle for Sponsored Products recommendation models, from raw data to features, training and real-time serving. We value ownership, getting things done, and close collaboration with science partners. We invest in mentorship and in tools that make engineers and scientists more productive, including AI-assisted development. - 3+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience - 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience - 1+ years of building large-scale machine-learning infrastructure for online recommendation, ads ranking, personalization or search experience - 1+ years of machine learning, statistical modeling, data mining, and analytics techniques experience - Experience programming with at least one software programming language - 1+ years of mathematics optimization such as linear programming and nonlinear optimization experience - Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. jobs.title: Applied Scientist, Ads Brand Safety and Suitability
jobs.jd: Amazon Ads Brand Safety & Suitability protects advertisers from exposure to unsafe, unsuitable, or policy-violating content across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio advertising inventory. Our mission is to ensure that every ad impression delivered through Amazon's demand-side platform appears adjacent to content that meets advertiser trust expectations while giving brands granular controls to define suitability on their own terms. We operate at the intersection of advertiser trust, publisher quality, and supply integrity. AI is fundamentally changing the content landscape. Content is now generated at unprecedented scale, faster, cheaper, and increasingly sophisticated. Low-quality, deceptive, AI-generated, and synthetic content evolves in real time, constantly adapting to evade detection. The volume and velocity of new content entering the advertising system has outpaced traditional classification approaches. We are looking for an Applied Scientist to work on the next generation of AI-powered Brand Safety and Content Classification systems designed to protect advertisers and elevate supply quality at internet scale. This is not a traditional classification problem. You will build systems that make millisecond-level decisions across billions of content signals while continuously adapting to emerging content risks driven by generative AI. You will own the science strategy for LLM-powered classification and semantic understanding, real-time multimodal content evaluation, adversarial ML and adaptive model resilience, proactive risk intelligence and content risk hunting, AI-generated and synthetic content detection, and large-scale abusive content system identification and disruption. You will define how modern AI separates high-quality advertising inventory from unsafe, unsuitable, and policy-violating content, across web, mobile app, CTV, and audio surfaces. What Makes This Role Unique Generative AI has dramatically lowered the cost of producing deceptive, policy-evasive content, and the adversary evolves daily. Your detection systems must reason contextually, adapt rapidly, and generalize beyond previously seen content risk patterns. Static models fail here; you will build living systems that learn and respond in real time. You will do this at internet scale, developing low-latency ML and LLM-powered systems evaluating content safety, brand suitability, misinformation risk, and emerging content risk vectors across massive real-time traffic streams, making billions of decisions per day with single-digit millisecond latency constraints. This role sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and large-scale production engineering, combining deep science, system-wide impact, and business-critical outcomes. The models your team ships directly influence billions of dollars in advertising spend and the trust of the world's largest brands in Amazon DSP. The Science Problems Are Genuinely Hard You will tackle challenges including detecting sophisticated AI-generated and synthetic content, understanding nuanced contextual brand risk, identifying coordinated MFA space before they scale, balancing precision, recall, latency, explainability, and fairness, designing adaptive models resilient to adversarial evolution, and leveraging LLMs for semantic understanding in real-time, latency-constrained environments. Why This Matters Few roles offer the opportunity to work at the intersection of frontier AI, internet-scale production systems, adversarial environments, and business-critical impact, while tackling open-ended scientific challenges with real-world societal relevance. As AI reshapes the internet, the systems your team builds will define what trustworthy, high-quality digital systems look like for the next decade. Key job responsibilities - Own the science strategy for AI-powered brand safety classification. - Build LLM-powered content classification systems making billions of decisions/day at single-digit millisecond latency - Develop multimodal evaluation pipelines reasoning across text, images, audio, and video in real time - Design adaptive ML systems resilient to adversarial evolution, semantic understanding for nuanced contextual brand risk. - Define measurement frameworks and drive continuous improvement - Translate research into production, own the path from prototype to deployed model - Publish at peer-reviewed venues; contribute to the scientific community in adversarial ML, NLP, and content safety - Collaborate with software engineering teams to integrate successful experiments into large-scale, highly complex Amazon production systems. - PhD, or a Master's degree and experience in CS, CE, ML or related field - Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing - Experience in building machine learning models for business application - Experience using Unix/Linux - Experience in professional software development Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. Amazon Advertising is looking for an Applied Scientist III to help solve it at global scale, applying advanced AI, graph neural networks, and probabilistic modeling to connect billions of identity signals across devices, publishers, and the open internet. jobs.jd: The Amazon Center for Quantum Computing (CQC) is seeking an Applied Scientist to research and design cryogenic control hardware for large-scale quantum processors, with an emphasis on superconducting digital circuits. Controlling and reading out orders of magnitude more qubits than today's systems demands rethinking where classical control lives and what technology implements it; you will design and model superconducting digital logic (e.g., single-flux-quantum-family circuits) and related cryogenic electronics, evaluate them against the wiring, power, and thermal budgets of a scaled system, and co-design control approaches with the qubit devices they serve. You will carry designs from concept through simulation, layout, design review, and fabrication handoff, and your evaluations will inform which control-electronics directions the organization invests in. Key job responsibilities • Design and simulate superconducting digital circuits and cryogenic control/readout electronics for scalable qubit control • Develop and validate Josephson-junction circuit models, timing and margin analyses, and verification methodology for superconducting digital designs • Quantify system-level trade-offs — wiring count, power dissipation at each cryogenic stage, latency, footprint — across candidate control architectures, and communicate recommendations • Co-design control interfaces with qubit-device colleagues so control electronics and quantum devices are developed as one system • Deliver design artifacts through the organization's design-request and design-review processes, including tapeout-ready layouts and verification reports • Present results internally and, where appropriate, publish in peer-reviewed venues About the team The Enabling Technologies team develops technologies and relationships facilitating scaling, including alternative quantum processor architectures, superconducting qubit device packaging, and cryogenic control device electronics. We work alongside a co-located quantum processor design team focused on current-generation devices; the two teams share design and review processes, and moving ideas between them is an explicit part of our charter. - jobs.jd: Alassio recherche son (sa) prochain(e) AI Engineer ! Missions 🏗️ Alassio en quelques mots En France, la paie et le social comptent parmi les fonctions les plus réglementées qui soient. Entre inflation réglementaire et évolutions légales et conventionnelles incessantes, la conformité est devenue un véritable fardeau pour les cabinets de paie et les services RH : ce fardeau les empêche de se consacrer à ce qui compte vraiment, le conseil et l'accompagnement des salariés, qui en subissent donc eux aussi le poids c'est aussi l'un des métiers où l'attrition est la plus forte en France, notamment parce que 60 % du temps des gestionnaires de paie est encore consacré à de la saisie ou à de la relecture manuelle Pourtant, des solutions technologiques majeures existent : l'IA permet en particulier d'automatiser une très grande partie des tâches les plus pénibles et de valoriser les données sociales. Mais le secteur reste largement à l'écart de cette révolution, et le problème n'est pas seulement réglementaire : le marché était verrouillé par des éditeurs historiques vieillissants, difficiles à quitter faute d'alternative crédible et de moyens pour migrer efficacement. Là aussi, l'IA fait voler ces barrières en éclats et ouvre la voie à une vague d'innovation attendue depuis des décennies. C'est pour y répondre qu'Alassio construit la plateforme de paie et de gestion RH moderne qui manquait à ce marché , au service des cabinets et de leurs clients TPE/PME. Notre ambition est de développer en un temps record : une plateforme collaborative et ouverte , qui s'intègre nativement aux outils des cabinets et de leurs clients, respecte leurs habitudes de travail et fluidifie les échanges entre gestionnaires de paie et entreprises l'automatisation de la tenue administrative : collecte des données, paramétrage des évolutions légales et des règles propres à chaque entreprise, génération automatique des rapports et formulaires, traçabilité juridique dynamique et en temps réel, etc. la valorisation des données de paie et sociales , pour offrir un conseil social à 360° et enfin répondre efficacement à l'ensemble des attentes des salariés, qui se sont de surcroît largement amplifiées depuis le Covid : gestion contractuelle, pilotage de la masse salariale, avantages salariés, fidélisation des talents, mutuelle… L'objectif : devenir le « People OS » sur lequel les cabinets et leurs clients TPE/PME s'appuient pour gérer l'intégralité de leurs problématiques paie et RH. 🚀 Tes responsabilités Ta mission : faire de l'IA le levier qui démultiplie le travail de chacun chez Alassio. L'objectif est assumé : multiplier par 10 la productivité de chaque membre de l'équipe. Tu formes la Growth squad avec notre Founding Strategy & Operations : ce binôme transverse optimise l'existant, automatise les workflows de toutes les équipes et fait passer nos initiatives IA et nos outils internes à l'échelle : hébergement et mise en production dans des environnements partagés, sécurité, observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue Tu deviens le (la) référent(e) IA d'Alassio : on se veut profondément AI-native et on expérimente énormément. Tu centralises et coordonnes ces initiatives pour que ce "lab interne" soit efficace, et tu expérimentes aussi en continu avec toutes les techno IA (budget et outillage conséquents) Tu construis la nouvelle colonne vertébrale IT d'Alassio , en identifiant les systèmes IA qui comptent à l'échelle de toute l'entreprise Tu prépares l'avenir du produit : à terme, les usages testés et éprouvés en interne sous ton impulsion ont vocation à rejoindre notre plateforme. Ils nourriront le « People OS » qui démocratise les cas d'usage les plus pertinents de l'IA dans notre secteur 🧭 Tes premiers chantiers Ton point de départ : Bedrock, notre OS interne. Un peu à la manière de Palantir Foundry, il agrège & orchestre tout le contexte de l'entreprise pour en tirer des actions concrètes : suivi ultra-personnalisé et automatisé de nos utilisateurs, analyse produit, documentation, rédaction de tickets et PR associées… Bedrock est déjà au cœur du quotidien de toutes les équipes. Mais il s'est construit par couches successives, au fil des cas d'usage ajoutés. Ton premier objectif est d'en dresser l'inventaire complet, process et outils IA compris. Tu définis ensuite la roadmap qui le fera changer de dimension : Workflows : optimiser l'existant Infrastructure : sécurité, confidentialité, hébergement et environnements partagés, pour un OS multi-joueur, plug-and-play et scalable Observabilité : suivre les agents et leur performance, et améliorer chaque logique en continu Autonomie : construire des workflows agentiques déclenchés par webhook ou planifiés, qui nettoient le contexte et mènent des missions 24/7 Très vite, tu as vocation à devenir le (la) responsable qui orchestre l'IA chez Alassio, et le (la) référent(e) de notre OS Bedrock. Profil recherché 🌱 Expérience 1 à 2 ans d'expérience dans un rôle d'AI Engineer / FDE / AI Deployment Strategist dans une top structure tech (BCGX, Palantir, Dust) Plusieurs missions concrètes de déploiement et d'optimisation de technologies IA : mise en place de zéro d'un workflow au sein d'une organisation, sujets de gouvernance et de déploiement en entreprise, etc. Une utilisation intensive des outils IA et une bonne maîtrise de Python : Claude Code / Codex ; Cursor Agents, Linear/PostHog, déploiement et hébergement (cloud, AI routers, etc.) 💎 Qualités Un goût pour l'optimisation et l'organisation : tu aimes que les choses soient claires, que l'information soit facile à mobiliser, propre et maintenable, et tu prends plaisir à produire vite des éléments actionnables Un biais très fort pour l'action : tu repères les problèmes avant qu'on te les signale, et tu ne t'arrêtes jamais au diagnostic Penser à l'échelle : tu conçois dès le départ des solutions capables d'encaisser des montées en charge ×10 ou ×100, tout en restant pragmatique sur ce qui compte à court et moyen terme Processus

jobs.title: Applied Scientist II
jobs.jd: We are seeking Applied Scientists to join Amazon. In this role, you will develop and deploy the science of safe autonomy on highly dynamic robots, advancing the frontier through both foundational research and realization on hardware. You will contribute to achieving safe autonomy across three key areas: control barrier function (CBF) theory for robust and performant safety on hardware; safe reinforcement learning for agile whole-body control; and layered safety filters that interface with learning, perception, and semantic reasoning systems. You will validate your work experimentally on state-of-the-art robotic platforms — removing bottlenecks to deployment and enabling robots to safely operate around humans. You will work with the inventor of CBFs, as well as top scientists and engineers at Amazon developing the next generation of safe autonomy. Key job responsibilities -Advance the science of safe autonomy from formal foundations to the integration with learning and perception to validation on hardware — with particular emphasis on methods that bridge these domains. -Test and validate hardware, with a focus on next generation robotic systems. Including locomotion, manipulation and loco-manipulation. -Leverage the deployments on hardware to validate the underlying science, identifying gaps between theory and practice that drive the next cycle of research. hardware to validate the underlying science, identifying gaps between theory and practice that drive the next cycle of research. -Publish research at top-tier robotics, control, and ML venues, and contribute to Amazon’s scientific reputation in advanced robotics. -Collaborate with SAF Lab and Amazon production teams to move research into robots deployed at Amazon scale. At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply! About the team The Safe Autonomy Frontiers (SAF) Lab is the first industry research lab dedicated to safe autonomy, founded by the inventor of control barrier functions. We are developing a universal safety layer for the next generation of robotic systems: mobile robots, manipulators, quadrupeds, and humanoids. Here you will advance performant safety for highly dynamic robots — CBF theory integrated with perception and learning, evaluated on next-generation platforms — and your work will underpin robots operating alongside people at Amazon’s unprecedented scale. - PhD or equivalent research experience - Master’s degree and 3+ years of applied science, research, or robotics engineering experience — OR a PhD — in computer science, robotics, control, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field. - Proficiency in C++ and Python, with a track record of implementing control algorithms and/or learning policies in real systems. - Experience with physics simulators for robotics (e.g., Isaac Gym/Sim, MuJoCo, PyBullet). - Experience taking robotics or autonomy research from prototype to deployed product, including collaboration with hardware, product, and operations teams. - Understanding of autonomous systems, reduced-order models, layered control architectures, nonlinear control, reachability methods, legged locomotion, and whole-body control. - Knowledge of learning-based approaches to robotics (e.g., reinforcement learning, diffusion, VLAs, VLMs, world models). - Exposure learning-based approaches for CBF synthesis (e.g., neural CBFs, data-driven barrier functions) and the integration of CBFs into learning (e.g., CBF-RL). - Understanding of control systems engineering, with a focus on layered architecture in robotic systems (high-level planning, mid-level trajectory generation, low-level feedback control). - Experience with perception on robotic systems (e.g., depth-camera and LiDAR-based sensing, sensor fusion, semantic tagging), together with mapping and navigation. - Familiarity with Hamilton-Jacobi reachability analysis and its relationship to CBF-based approaches. - Knowledge of safety-constrained RL (e.g., constrained MDPs, Lagrangian methods, shielding, CBF-based policy filtering). - Familiarity with real-time deployment constraints (latency budgets, onboard compute limitations, control-loop frequencies). - Experience building or contributing to large-scale RL training infrastructure (distributed training, GPU clusters). - Strong communication skills and ability to work across disciplinary boundaries (ML, controls, mechanical engineering). jobs.title: Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI
jobs.jd: As an Advisory Solution Consultant - CRM & Agentic AI for the Switzerland market, you are the technical face of a fundamentally different way of selling. Rather than leading with slideware and scripted demos, you embed alongside the customer, run deep Discovery to isolate one high-value problem, and then prove value in the open — building a working Proof of Value (POV) on the customer’s own data using our Agentic workflow capabilities. You partner with Sales, Product Management, and Executive Leadership to turn a single, well-chosen use case into undeniable, data-backed proof that earns the next phase of the relationship. This role blends the consultative instincts of a Sr. Advisory Solution Consultant with the hands-on, build-it-in-the-field engineering of a forward-deployed engineer: someone who works inside the customer’s own environment, configuring and proving solutions on their live data rather than presenting finished products from the outside. The Embedded Approach The Advisory Solution Consultant inverts the traditional pre-sales motion. Product demonstration is deliberately minimal — just enough to establish credibility and unlock the real work. The center of gravity is the POV: a short, focused cycle where we get access to a slice of the customer’s data, stand up an Agentic workflow against a problem they genuinely care about, and let the outcome speak for itself. Your job is to earn the right to that POV through rigorous Discovery, then deliver it as an embedded engineer, not a presenter. What You’ll Do As the Advisory Solution Consultant, you will lead a Discovery-first, POV-centric engagement model — using your technical depth and Agentic workflow expertise to convert customer data into proven outcomes, while supporting quarterly and annual sales objectives for your region. Key responsibilities include: Partner with Sales as the embedded technical lead — someone who wins on proof, not presentation — to drive transformational CRM opportunities. Lead rigorous Discovery to isolate a single, high-value problem worth solving, mapping the customer’s data, systems, and desired outcome before any product is shown. Keep product demonstration minimal and purposeful — use it only to establish credibility and to set up the POV, never as a substitute for proving value on real data. Secure and scope a POV: earn customer sponsorship to engage in a hands-on cycle where we use their data to solve the identified problem with our Agentic workflow capabilities. Build and deliver the POV as an embedded engineer — configuring Agentic workflows against the customer’s environment and producing measurable, data-backed results. Translate POV outcomes into an executive value narrative that quantifies impact and defines the path from a single proven use case to enterprise-wide adoption. Collaborate with Product Management using field and POV learnings to shape Agentic workflow, integration (e.g. ERP), and AI-driven capabilities that address real enterprise needs. Ensure every Discovery and POV engagement aligns with regional data privacy laws, security expectations, and enterprise compliance standards for handling customer data. Codify reusable POV assets, Discovery frameworks, and Agentic workflow patterns so the embedded POV motion scales across the team. Represent the company at enterprise events, technology forums, and leadership summits as a credible, hands-on technical voice for the embedded POV approach. What We’re Looking For To succeed in this role, you should bring: Builder Mindset: A builder’s instinct — comfortable getting hands on with a customer’s data and environment to prove value directly, rather than relying on canned demonstrations. POV-Centric Selling: Proven ability to scope, sell, and deliver Proof-of-Value engagements that convert a single problem into quantified, data-backed outcomes. Discovery Rigor: Exceptional discovery skills to quickly isolate the one problem worth solving and secure customer commitment to a POV. Agentic & AI Fluency: Deep, practical understanding of Agentic workflows and AI-driven automation, and how to apply them to CRM problems on live customer data. CRM Expertise: Deep hands-on experience in CRM and customer experience, with strong knowledge of service, sales, lead & opportunity management. Enterprise Experience: Proven track record engaging large organizations and earning executive sponsorship for hands-on, data-driven engagements. Communication Skills: Exceptional ability to translate technical POV results into clear, business-oriented value stories for senior enterprise stakeholders. Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional, global teams spanning Sales, Product, and delivery. Language: fluency in English and French/German Qualifications Demonstrated experience building or delivering POVs, prototypes, or hands-on technical engagements — a hands-on track record of proving value on real customer data, not just presenting it. Hands-on experience applying AI and Agentic workflow capabilities to solve business problems — automating workflows, orchestrating AI agents, and analyzing AI-driven outcomes within CRM or adjacent enterprise contexts. 10+ years of pre-sales solution consulting or sales engineering experience, with a clear shift toward Discovery-led, proof-based selling.
